title: TOBA and Toby time
summary: Jackson and Hinton explain the Theater Owners' Booking Association circuit of segregated black shows and its nickname.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: When you say a Toby show, what does Toby mean besides --
That's right. They booked different little theaters, one-night stands all around the South, with black shows.
Yeah, and so we had a little expression --
But in the soul, in the black society we had another name called --
Yeah, we had another name for it called Tough On Black Asses.
Yeah, because there was a -- the right [was] playing all of these segregated places --
-- and all of the things that it took to get through in the form, with the segregation policies at the time.
